NineNine — original precision audio, 2026-10-29

The music composition, short UI/hit/miss effects and their synthesis code were
created for Kamilunavo by the Codex implementation agent under the owner's
instruction. The WAV files are generated exclusively from mathematical sine
oscillators and envelopes by scripts/generate_original_audio.py. No samples,
outside artist recordings, plugin/demo music, downloaded audio or voice inputs
were used. This is a source-of-authorship statement, not an attribution of a
third-party licence or a claim that public-domain/CC0 material was used.

See PROVENANCE.json for exact generator/output hashes and the original score.
